description:
#Plenty of space for you and your crew to enjoy!

##About

**Please note, you must have prior sailing experience in order to rent. We instruction for those without sailing experience**

- Accommodates up to 8 passengers
- Must be 18+ with a valid Driver's License to operate & rent
what_is_included:
- Equipped with a Roller furling jib.
- Very stable
- Large walk-through cabin
- Cabin has a table and seating area
- Life vests included

what_is_included_items.value: Equipped with a Roller furling jib.
Cabin has a table and seating area

restrictions:
All boats are required to stay within the bay
- No beaching or swimming at any time
- All passengers must depart and return to our rental locations
